utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all. You alright? Let's get started, quick stand-up for Monday. Just run round the board and pick up anything live for today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Morning. Bit nippy in here again, by the way, the heating in the portakabin is still doing basically nothing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I was gonna say, fingers don't work till about half eight in there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Could be worse, there's a birthday cake in the office, so at least morale's covered.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Whose is it?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No idea, I just saw it and thought, right, that's my breakfast sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Excellent, very professional. Right, actual work. Callum, production first?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so line 1's fine. Line 2 had that stop again on the robot cell overnight, bit of a jam by the pick head. It's not running clean at the minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. We need the jam clearing and the sensors checked on the line 2 robot.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the line 2 robot, should have that done by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, thanks Olumide. Anything else on line 2 while we're there?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just as an aside, I finished the repair on the GT1 compressor last night, so that's done, nothing for today on that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And from my side, I already swapped the filter on the turbine one gas valve yesterday, so that's off the list as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Closed jobs, lovely. Hannah, quality?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. No fresh NCRs from nights. I did see the pressure on the HV board dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so just an observation really, not asking for anything off this call.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Funny you say that, I saw the pressure on the number two bearing dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own as well. Same sort of thing, just noting it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, log both, but we're not spinning up new jobs from that now if it's recovered.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Mm. Also, blocker-wise, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the fire panel, so I can't move that one on yet.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I've chased them twice. Still waiting, same position.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, blocked is blocked. Keep chasing, but that's not a task for this morning meeting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same story on another one, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line two. So I'm a bit stuck there as well till they come back.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That'll be the replacement bits, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Can't do much till we've actually got a date.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Fiona, planning?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Main thing, just so nobody starts stripping anything, we were looking at line 3 work, but I think you've already got that, Sarah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, just to be clear, we were going to replace the belt on the line 3 but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Happy days, one less filthy job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Don't sound too pleased, Tom. Right, safety side. We still need to update the risk assessment for work on the line 2 interlock, on the 3rd, top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that's got to be in before the job starts.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I've got the permit pack mostly lined up, but the risk assessment bit needs an owner.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: So, update the risk assessment for work on the line 2 interlock, on the 3rd, top priority please. Who can take that?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can help with the wording maybe, but I've got my hands full on breakdown follow-ups.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'm tied up with audit evidence this morning and supplier chasing. I can't commit to it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Not me, if I'm on the line 2 robot and then the other controls backlog.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can give operational input, but I can't sit and own the document today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, okay, noted then: update the risk assessment for work on the line 2 interlock, on the 3rd, top priority please, but nobody's actually picking it up in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll flag it red on the board then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Do that. Next one, yard and FLT side: I'll do the pre-use checks on the trucks.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, that helps, we're a bit thin first thing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No problem, I'll get those done straight after this.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, while I've got you, toolbox talk for the team still needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team. Normal priority, I'll just grab them between jobs once everyone's in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good man.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I've not really got much else from plant. Boilers steady, CHP behaved overnight for once.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright. Marcus Hale, can you send the shift handover report round today? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, no problem, I'll send the shift handover report round today. No rush taken literally, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha, within reason. Just before lunch is fine.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, fair.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Anything on staffing? I've got Dan off sick still.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I've covered packing with agency for the first half. We'll juggle after ten if needed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: On line 2, once Olumide's been in, give me a shout if there was product trapped in the cell. I might need to quarantine a couple of trays.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, will do. But just to be clear, my bit is the jam and sensor check, not starting a full strip unless it's obvious.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's all we need for now.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: If line 2 comes back by 11, I can keep the afternoon plan as is. If not, I'll have to reshuffle despatch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, update Fiona once you've had eyes on, Olumide.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Do you want me to cover anything on permits later, or leave it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Leave permits for now. Bigger issue is still that risk assessment on the line 2 interlock hasn't got an owner.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: If somebody frees up after lunch we can revisit it, but right now, no.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Bit tight today, innit.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Mondays.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Always. Anything else that's definitely not a task, just so it's heard?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, aside from the supplier thing and that pressure dip, that's me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same here. Fire panel's blocked till the supplier answers, nothing else.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I've just got routine PMs. And cake management.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Critical support function, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Essential service. Right, recap before we drop: Olumide will clear the jam and check the sensors on the line 2 robot by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll do the pre-use checks on the trucks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom will organise the toolbox talk for the team, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale will send the shift handover report round today, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the risk assessment for work on the line 2 interlock on the 3rd is top priority please, but currently unowned, so it's flagged.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Marked red.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one. Thanks everyone, crack on.
